description: Defines an abstract base class for CLI commands using @oclif/core, including environment setup, process termination handling, and command flags.

classes.name: BaseCommand
classes.description: Abstract class extending @oclif/core Command, providing common setup and termination logic for CLI commands.

methods.name: stopProcess
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping the process, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: onTerminate
methods.description: Returns an async function to handle termination signals, including forced shutdown after 30 seconds.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes command, sets up signal handlers, error logging, and environment variables from flags.
